About Evil Glasses
Two people. A pair of cursed glasses. We make books, stories, games, and apps. Enjoy!
We are writers and game developers an Evil Glasses is our label. Find out about our publications, games, and more at evilglasses.com.
Our Staff
Sara Lufrano
Sara lives in Seattle with her family and adopted pets. She enjoys going to festivals, conventions, training her dog, and traveling. She writes her books as Sara Rogers.
Marshall
Marshall is a software engineer and writer. When not playing video games, he finds time to write stories and work on his many side projects.
